Headings become ids that keep their capitals and punctuation, while the links authors write use the lowercase-and-hyphens slug every other Markdown tool produces. Both ends have to end up naming the same thing.

Release.Notes

Two headings whose ids differ only in punctuation that matching drops are one key, so this is left exactly as written rather than guessed at.

not an anchor is untouched, and so is an unknown target.

概要

A heading with no ASCII in it at all still has to become an id made of its own characters rather than the literal word "heading": the summary.

詳細

A second such heading is a heading of its own, not the numbered fallback that one emptied id forces on the next.
